name: Fernwood Cove
description_short: Traditional overnight camp for girls on Island Pond in Harrison, Maine, about an hour from Portland. Each girl attends one half summer session and builds her own schedule from more than 60 activities in sports, arts, outdoor adventure, waterfront and horsemanship.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp sits on Island Pond. Campers take one week of instructional swimming each session until they have finished 7th grade and reached Red Cross swim level 6.
